svg.text: claudia — styling suite 2.1: editing an object that has two slots
Proposal for review. The same popover (Format ▸ Edit this style…, Shift+F10) and the same editor in All styles, in all three apps. Drawn for creates; computes and composes look the same.
A · A text box: its words
The slot switcher says which part is being styled.
every use of Body text — 14 places
this text box only — a new “Body text (changed)”
B · The same text box: its box
Only Box properties; the gallery shows what fits.
Whole styles that also set a box — their box part:
A text box's box reads only these. A shape uses an
outline instead; a cell adds vertical alignment and wrapping.
this text box only — a new “Callout (changed)”
C · A shape: its outline, or its label
Two slots again, with other names.
every use of Plain shape — 6 places
With “Label · Shape label” chosen, the popover shows
Text and Paragraph sections, exactly as in A.
A picture has one slot and no controls: the switcher
and the editor are not shown, only the gallery.
A chart has one slot, its box: as B, without a switcher.
The slot switcher replaces today's single “Style” header. Each half names the slot and the style it holds, so a person sees both at once; the one the menu opens on is the words of a text box
and the outline of a shape (as now).
The gallery shows only the styles that fit the slot (D316). For a box, box styles come first; whole styles that set a box follow under their own line, because putting one there uses only its
box part — a whole style that sets no box is not offered for a box.
One section per facet the slot reads, in the fixed order Text, Paragraph, Box, Outline; a facet the slot does not read is left out, not disabled (D209). The CSS switch of the agreed editor
stays, per section. The All styles editor (agreed: all-styles-edit.svg) uses the same sections, showing every facet the style's kind can hold, since no slot is chosen there.
“This … only” makes a new style from the slot's style for this object and this slot (deviate, D75, D309); the other slot is untouched. The count is the number of places in all slots that
A border is set per side: the small square picks the side or sides, the field beside it the line. In the gallery a box style is drawn with its own background and border, at text size — that
is the whole of its look.
A shape has the same two slots under its own names, outline and label. A picture has one slot and nothing to set, so it gets the gallery only; a chart has one slot, its box, and gets B
